# porch_group (Data Source)

Looks up a group of a tenant by ID or slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porch_group" "kids" {
  tenant = "smiths"
  slug   = "kids"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant` (String) Tenant ID or slug.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Group ID. Exactly one of `id` and `slug` must be set.
- `slug` (String) Group slug.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `members` (Set of String) IDs of direct member users.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `parents` (Set of String) IDs of parent groups.
